st: Autumn and Winter: Against All Odds

st: And the Moonbeams Kiss the Sea
d: When a maintenance engineer is found dead in the basement of the Bodleian library, Lewis and Hathaway investigate a link between the murder and an intruder at a local professor's home earlier in the night. Suspicion grows when they visit the engineer's house and discover rare nineteenth-century books, which were taken from the library in which he worked.

In county Sligo on the west coast of Ireland, Colum Stapleton runs the uniquely designed eco-lodge The Gyreum with his daughter Finn. But whilst the surroundings of the Wild West are idyllic, the offering is anything but, and when Alex insists that the owner needs to roll up his sleeves and fix the place up, sparks fly.
